==================================================
Emmer-Compascuum (small area)
CityGML 2.0 city-scale test dataset with Energy ADE 3.0 (beta 8)
==================================================

City-scale test area in Emmer-Compascuum, the Netherlands,
encoded in CityGML 2.0 with the Energy ADE 3.0 (beta 8).
Buildings come from BAG + 3DBAG (LoD 0/1/2); EP-Online
energy labels are omitted so the document can be shared
openly. Enriched with rooftop solar panels, LoD3 trees,
and CBS Postcode-6 dwelling-energy aggregates.

Last update: 2026-06-10

Provenance
==================================================
Generated by Daan Schlosser for his MSc thesis in
Geomatics at the 3D Geoinformation group, Delft
University of Technology, the Netherlands, under the
RenoDAT research project (TU Delft / NWO, 2025 to 2029).

Dataset (4TU.ResearchData): https://doi.org/10.4121/89f8909b-4473-4958-8f93-46b55546764d

Data sources
==================================================
BAG and BGT (CC0); 3DBAG, CBS Postcode-6, the municipality
boundary, and University of Groningen solar panels (all
CC-BY-4.0); CFTree tree reconstructions from AHN6 (data
CC-BY-4.0, algorithm GPL-3.0). EP-Online energy labels are
deliberately omitted. See the dataset README for the full
attribution table.

Viewing
==================================================
To visualise the data and explore the attributes you can
use the freeware KITModelViewer:
https://www.iai.kit.edu/1302.php

city_model.name: Emmer-Compascuum (small area, no energy labels)
city_model.description: Emmer-Compascuum small-area test AOI: BAG + 3DBAG LoD 0/1/2, with EP-online energy labels omitted (include_energy_labels: false) so the document can be redistributed openly. Extended with solar panel polygons from the University of Groningen aerial-imagery dataset (Zenodo 14860030, CC-BY-4.0), LoD3 tree reconstructions from CFTree (AHN6 LiDAR -> HOMED + TreeSeparation + CGAL alpha-wrap), pre-merged + clipped + deduped via tools/merge_cftree_tiles.py, optionally enriched with OSM species/leaf_type and Landelijk Register Monumentale Bomen, and CBS Postcode6 dwelling-energy aggregates (gemiddeldGasverbruikWoning m3/yr, gemiddeldElektriciteitsverbruikWoning kWh/yr) attached as nrg3:UrbanFunctionArea features per postcode polygon. Boundary polygon from inputs/boundaries/emmer-compascuum_small-area.geojson.
